"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trumpism is based on overt appeals to white racial resentment and prejudice.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trumpism promotes misogyny, anti-LGBTQIA bigotry, and ableism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To vanquish Trumpism, efforts must have explicitly anti-racist politics at their core.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To vanquish Trumpism, efforts must openly oppose sexism, homophobia, queerphobia, and transphobia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To build working-class solidarity necessary for victory, the voices of those who are under attack need to be uplifted and centered.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The fight against Trumpism is prioritized not only because of its strategic importance, but also out of deep moral conviction.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The struggles against racism and other forms of oppression are central to the vision of democratic socialism.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Biden administration’s record so far improves over past Democratic administrations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA should work to ensure the Biden administration does not backslide from its stated improved commitments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Enlarging Democratic congressional majorities and bolstering their progressive memberships will greatly contribute to legislative progress.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The political analysis and prescriptions laid out in Resistance Rising, adopted by the 2015 DSA Convention, should be followed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The approach from Resistance Rising led to DSA’s role in the 2016 and 2020 Bernie Sanders presidential campaigns that brought unprecedented attention to democratic socialism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The 2016 and 2020 Bernie Sanders presidential campaigns garnered DSA thousands of new members.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA is now in a position to make democratic socialism into a potent force in U.S. politics, but only if the strategic approach is maintained.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
